adoptionRule.rule: Native version adopted only when every production behaviour remains represented, no production validation/route/export/default is lost, no ordering-sensitive side effect changes, error semantics do not regress, and the Native addition is accepted AI Native responsibility.
adoptionRule.method: full diff read for every file; route/export/default/order/side-effect/error-semantics checked individually; focused production tests executed where an existing one covers the behaviour

reclassified.reason: Changes persistent idempotency behaviour of a formal business command and moves three production-only content lines; the coordinator requires manual review for shared business algorithms.
reclassified.nativeDelta: adds orderCreateRequestFingerprint(); executeOrderCreate now fingerprints the ORIGINAL normalised request instead of the rebuilt draft payload

behaviourChange.before: idempotency fingerprint input = { payload: { customerId, customerName, contractNo, remark, status, itemsJson, purchaseListJson, todosJson }, previewHash } taken from the rebuilt draft
behaviourChange.after: idempotency fingerprint input = { customerId, customerName, contractNo, remark, items from the original request body, previewHash }
behaviourChange.whyItMatters: this is the N4.2C-IDEMPOTENCY-REPLAY-REPAIR: rebuilding the purchase plan of an already-active order changed the fingerprint and broke replay. The repair is a real defect fix, but it changes the stored command fingerprint for order creation, so it must be an explicit production decision rather than a silent Phase 4 adoption.
